analysis: Aggressive net selling across both spot and perpetual swaps has driven price below the Value Area Low ($81,300), confirming short-term bearish order flow dominance. High derivative volume relative to spot indicates leverage is driving the current breakdown, creating heightened risk of liquidity sweeps.
key_risk: Inability for spot passive buyers to absorb derivative selling and reclaim $81,300 (VAL/POC), opening risk for further liquidation-driven expansion lower.
